feature: gRPC TLS channels through authenticated HTTP CONNECT proxy

scope.proxy: HTTP/1.1 CONNECT with caller-owned headers and limits
scope.origin_transport: certificate-verified TLS 1.3 with mandatory h2 ALPN
scope.routing: optional CONNECT tunnel_authority independent from TLS and gRPC origin identity

observed_contract: CONNECT proxy routing precedes the origin HTTP/2 handshake
proxy authentication belongs only to the HTTP/1.1 CONNECT request
origin TLS identity and HTTP authority remain independent from the proxy address
one caller budget covers proxy connection, CONNECT, TLS, ALPN, HTTP/2 bootstrap, and RPC readiness
a tunneled HTTP/2 connection remains reusable for later gRPC streams

implementation.endpoint: tls_host accepts an optional ChannelHttpConnectProxy; proxied host endpoints bypass local origin DNS in ordinary and SharedChannel resolver setup
implementation.tunnel_authority: HttpConnectProxy optionally overrides only the CONNECT authority while connectTlsStream retains the requested host and origin authority
implementation.identity: TLS SNI, certificate verification, default :authority, exporter ownership, gRPC metadata, backoff, and picker identity remain origin-bound
implementation.credentials: proxy request headers are consumed by HTTP/1.1 CONNECT and cannot enter the origin HPACK field block
implementation.deadline: connectTlsHostViaProxyWithDeadline preserves the original awake-clock deadline across every setup layer
implementation.reuse: ordinary and background channels retain their existing persistent HTTP/2 ownership above the tunnel
implementation.resolver: an optional caller resolver may coexist with a proxied host but is not invoked for the proxy-resolved origin

native_cases: exact localhost:port CONNECT authority and Basic proxy authentication
certificate-pinned TLS 1.3 and h2 through the accepted tunnel
exact origin authority and Proxy-Authorization absence at the gRPC request
SharedChannel unary RPC through a second authenticated tunnel
two successful proxy accepts with complete ownership cleanup

process_case.proxy: Hyper HTTP/1.1 CONNECT server on Tokio
assertions: certificate verification and h2 ALPN succeed
proxy authentication is required and isolated
two canonical UnaryCall RPCs reuse one tunneled connection
request and response protobuf payload sizes are independently validated

verification_commands: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC Channels preserve origin identity' --summary all
remaining_gap: explicit authenticated HTTP CONNECT is complete; automatic grpc_proxy/https_proxy/no_proxy environment mapping, PAC, and SOCKS policy remain separate configuration work
